codes.NOT_CRAFTABLE: This network has no pattern that produces this resource.
codes.CRAFT_CALCULATION_FAILED: The crafting calculation failed or took too long.
codes.PLAN_NOT_READY: The crafting plan is still being calculated.
codes.PLAN_INCOMPLETE: Some ingredients are missing and cannot be crafted. The job cannot start.
codes.PLAN_STALE: The ME network changed since this plan was calculated. Calculate again.
codes.PLAN_NOT_FOUND: This crafting plan expired. Calculate again.
codes.NO_CRAFTING_CPU: This ME network has no crafting CPU.
codes.NO_SUITABLE_CPU: No crafting CPU can take this job right now: they are busy, offline, too small, or excluded.
codes.CPU_BUSY: The selected crafting CPU is busy.
codes.CPU_OFFLINE: The selected crafting CPU is offline.
codes.CPU_TOO_SMALL: The selected crafting CPU does not have enough crafting storage for this job.
codes.CPU_NOT_FOUND: That crafting CPU is no longer part of the network.
codes.MISSING_INGREDIENTS: Some ingredients are no longer in storage. Calculate the plan again.
codes.NOT_RUNNING: This job is not running anymore.
codes.CRAFT_REJECTED: The crafting system refused the job.
codes.ORDER_NOT_FOUND: This crafting order does not exist.
codes.INTERRUPTED: ME Control Center stopped while this order was being submitted. Check the crafting CPUs in game.
codes.TRACKING_LOST: This crafting CPU type cannot be followed across a server restart.
codes.JOB_LOST: The job has not been seen on any crafting CPU for a long time; its CPU may have been removed.
codes.OUTCOME_NOT_REPORTED: The job ended, but this crafting CPU type does not report whether it completed.
codes.DRAFT_NOT_FOUND: This pattern draft does not exist.
codes.PROVIDER_NOT_FOUND: That pattern provider is no longer part of the network.
codes.PATTERN_INVALID: This pattern cannot be encoded. See the validation messages.
codes.UNSUPPORTED_RESOURCE_TYPE: The pattern uses a resource type that cannot be put into patterns here.
codes.NO_BLANK_PATTERN: The network has no Blank Pattern. Nothing was encoded.
codes.NETWORK_NO_POWER: The network has too little stored energy. Nothing was encoded.
codes.PROVIDER_OFFLINE: The selected pattern provider is offline (no power or no channel).
codes.PROVIDER_FULL: The selected pattern provider has no free pattern slot.
codes.ENCODE_FAILED: The pattern could not be encoded. The Blank Pattern was returned.
codes.DEPLOY_FAILED: The pattern provider did not accept the pattern. The Blank Pattern was returned.
codes.VERIFY_FAILED: The pattern provider did not hold the pattern afterwards. The Blank Pattern was returned.
codes.PROVIDER_NOT_RENAMABLE: This kind of pattern provider cannot be renamed from ME Control Center.

pair.title: Pair this browser
pair.subtitle: Connect this browser to your Minecraft account. No password needed.
pair.step2: Enter the key shown in chat. It expires after a few minutes and works once.
pair.invalid: That key is invalid, expired, or already used. Run /mecc pair again for a new one.
pair.footnote: This browser stays signed in until you revoke it in Settings or with /mecc revoke.

reason.NOT_DISCOVERED_YET: ME Control Center is still scanning loaded networks.
reason.NOT_LOADED: None of its Wireless Access Points is loaded. Its chunks may be unloaded, or the access points were removed.
reason.BOOTING: The network is booting and assigning channels.
reason.CONTROLLER_CONFLICT: The network has conflicting ME controllers.
reason.SPLIT: This network's access points are now in separate ME networks. Live access is paused until they are connected again.
reason.MERGED: This network is now connected to another ME Control Center network. Live access is paused until they are separated again, so neither network's members gain access to the other.
